description: This file defines the Browser class, which is part of a larger web automation library, managing browser instances, contexts, pages, and related operations.

classes.name: Browser
classes.description: Represents a browser instance that manages multiple contexts and pages, handles connection state, and provides methods for browser operations.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a Browser instance from a channel object.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new Browser object with the given parent, type, GUID, and initializer.

methods.name: browserType
methods.description: Returns the browser type associated with this instance.

methods.name: newContext
methods.description: Creates a new browser context with optional parameters.

methods.name: _newContextForReuse
methods.description: Creates or reuses an existing browser context for performance optimization.

methods.name: _disconnectFromReusedContext
methods.description: Disconnects the browser from a reused context, cleaning up pages and context.

methods.name: _innerNewContext
methods.description: Internal method to create a new browser context, with options for reuse.

methods.name: _connectToBrowserType
methods.description: Associates this browser with a specific browser type and configuration.

methods.name: _didCreateContext
methods.description: Handles the event of a new context being created.

methods.name: _setupBrowserContext
methods.description: Configures a created browser context with default settings.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version string of the browser.

methods.name: newPage
methods.description: Creates a new page in a new browser context and returns it.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Indicates whether the browser is currently connected.

methods.name: newBrowserCDPSession
methods.description: Creates a new Chrome DevTools Protocol session.

methods.name: startTracing
methods.description: Starts performance tracing, optionally for a specific page.

methods.name: stopTracing
methods.description: Stops tracing and saves the trace data to a specified path.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the browser, optionally with a reason.

methods.name: _didClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the browser is closed.

ctags.name: Browser
ctags.pattern: /^export class Browser extends ChannelOwner<channels.BrowserChannel> implements api.Browser {$/

ctags.name: response
ctags.pattern: /^    const response = forReuse ? await this._channel.newContextForReuse(contextOptions) : await t/
